settings.title: Settings
settings.server_name_helper: Shown in the server browser and in the client.
settings.server_password_helper: Players must enter it to join. Empty: open server.
settings.gslt_token_placeholder: leave empty to keep the stored token
settings.gslt_token_helper: Token for app ID 730 from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. Without a token the server accepts LAN players only.
settings.gslt_not_set: No token stored — LAN players only.
settings.game_port_helper: Published on all node addresses and opened on the node firewall; RCON uses the TCP side. Default 27015.
settings.lan_mode_helper: No Steam authentication; only clients from the local network can join.
settings.map_group_helper: Map pool, e.g. mg_active, mg_reserves, mg_dust247. Ignored when a workshop map or collection is set.
settings.workshop_collection_helper: Steam Workshop collection to download; maps are then selected in the console with ds_workshop_changelevel.
settings.workshop_map_helper: Single Steam Workshop map to load at start.
settings.bot_quota_helper: 0: no bots. Bots join once the first player is connected.
settings.bqm_fill: fill (bots fill up to the quota)
settings.validate_files: Validate game files at every start
settings.validate_files_helper: SteamCMD verifies all files (slow); switch on after a broken customisation, off again afterwards.
settings.additional_args_helper: Appended to the cs2 start command.
settings.extra_env_helper: KEY=VALUE per line, passed to the joedwards32/cs2 image after the generated settings (see its README). Variables managed by this page are refused.
settings.status_starting: Container running — SteamCMD is installing/updating the game files (first start: ~70 GB free needed, 67 GB installed) or the server is still starting
settings.connect_desc: Install the free CS2 client from Steam, then join with the link below or in the game console: connect {address}
settings.connect_lan_note: Without a GSLT token only players in the local network can join.
settings.command_helper: e.g. status, changelevel de_dust2, bot_add, bot_kick, mp_restartgame 1, say Hello, ds_workshop_listmaps.
settings.port_in_use: Port already in use on this node
settings.port_same_as_game_port: CSTV port must differ from the game port
settings.invalid_characters: Quotes and line breaks are not allowed
settings.reserved_variable: Variable is managed by the settings page
settings.invalid_extra_env: Entries must look like KEY=VALUE (uppercase key)
